steps.objective: 完成「密度剖面介面」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Density-profile interface and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
夜側與日側混樣會偽造尺度高度變化；先按地方時與粒子種類分組。
對照「密度剖面介面」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。若 ln(n) 對高度明顯彎曲，報告分段 H，不把它直接當作逃逸率。
本階段必須重驗：圖上須能追蹤輸入至交付端。從兩高度密度估算局部尺度高度，辨認非靜力條件。
steps.instructionEn:
Mixing day and night measurements can mimic scale-height change; first group by local time and species.
Against the nominal Density-profile interface result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. If ln(n) versus altitude is curved, report piecewise H and do not label it an escape rate.
Reverify this criterion: The diagram must trace the input to its recipient. Estimate local scale height from densities at two altitudes and identify nonhydrostatic conditions.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。夜側與日側混樣會偽造尺度高度變化；先按地方時與粒子種類分組。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Mixing day and night measurements can mimic scale-height change; first group by local time and species.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.checkEn: The diagram must trace the input to its recipient. Estimate local scale height from densities at two altitudes and identify nonhydrostatic conditions.

steps.instruction:
交付高度密度表、對數擬合、第三點殘差與分組條件。
在交接件中加入「密度剖面介面」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：圖上須能追蹤輸入至交付端。從兩高度密度估算局部尺度高度，辨認非靜力條件。

Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Density-profile interface: The diagram must trace the input to its recipient. Estimate local scale height from densities at two altitudes and identify nonhydrostatic conditions.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Estimate local scale height from densities at two altitudes and identify nonhydrostatic conditions. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
